page.overview:
Who is Merno Blask?

Merno Blask was an Imperial governor of the planet of Trevura. He was opposed to droids, his open dislike for them resulting in an underground droid insurgency meant to put an end to his governorship. The assassin droid S-R6 was hired to kill him.
